note: What a server sends to say something happened that the whole match is told about. What sort of thing is named first, and what follows is settled by that.

fields.name: event
fields.note: What sort of thing happened, and so which shape follows. The captures hold five sorts, each once.

fields.name: source
fields.note: The unit the thing is credited to, or zero where none is.

fields.name: about
fields.note: What the thing is about. Its shape is settled by the sort named above, and no sort has been seen often enough to record one, so a reading end takes these as they come. Four bytes and eight bytes have both been observed, and where eight are carried they read as two numbers of four.
